jobs.prompt: Bump the version from 1.167.22 to 1.167.23. In package.json and package-lock.json (both places in the lock: the top version and packages[""].version) change 1.167.22 to 1.167.23. In README.md change every 1.167.22 pin (kickoff text, tag name) to 1.167.23. In these tests replace the current-version pin 1.167.22 with 1.167.23 everywhere it appears, in BOTH spellings: plain (1.167.22) and escaped inside regular expressions (the same digits with backslash-dot): tests/t101-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lesson-t80-cli.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-x.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ab-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ag-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ah-release.test.mjs. In CHANGELOG.md add a NEW top entry ## 1.167.23 above the 1.167.22 entry (keep it unchanged) with the lead-in line: Release train 1: four fixes for the parts build and the orchestrator guard. And these bullets, each starting with a bold lead word: Branches: integrate can commit to branches the project names in .project-swarm.json integrate.commitBranches (exact names or a trailing star), never to main, master or the default branch, and says why when it commits nothing; Splits: swarm resolve --superseded-splits [--stage S] [--dry-run] clears parked split blockers that a newer ingest of the same stage replaced, and keeps the current ones; Guard: in orchestrator mode, swarm run, go and ticket read the manifest and refuse checks, setup, preChecks or mutantCheck commands that are not vetted in coordination/checks.json or the profile verify command, and refuse shell jobs; Approve: swarm scope approve --auto-ok lets the orchestrator approve a change-order split only when code shows no paid lanes, no migrations, no deploy or merge to main and no cancelled done work, logs every decision and otherwise leaves a Needs-you item; plain approve stays owner-only. Do not touch any other file. The version has two digits in the last part: use exact matches so 1.167.23 is never confused with 1.167.2.
